# SpacePilot.dev — Autonomous Generative Cinema Workstation & Runtime

> SkyPilot pilots your cloud compute. SpacePilot pilots your generative cinema.

## System Overview
SpacePilot is a zero-cold-start generative video runtime, NLE workstation, and autonomous directing engine. It bridges AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Antigravity, Grok) with high-density GPU nodes (AWS Spot L40S 48GB @ $0.75/hr, Shadeform 20+ clouds) using FastMCP (Model Context Protocol).

## Core Capabilities
- **0.0s Resident LTX-2.5 Daemon**: Quantized Float8 checkpoint permanently loaded into 48GB VRAM.
- **In-Process Audio Mastering**: Kokoro-82M ONNX TTS with automatic 2-pass EBU R128 (-16 LUFS) loudnorm and sidechain BGM ducking.
- **4-Take Exploration Grid**: Deterministic seed stepping rendered concurrently in a 2x2 preview canvas.
- **3D Camera Trajectory**: Dynamic Pan, Tilt, Zoom, and Roll dials that scale STG spatial guidance vectors.
- **FLF2V Dual Keyframes**: First-Frame and Last-Frame morphing and cross-dissolve generation.
- **Dead Man's Switch**: Watchdog auto-terminating idle GPU instances after 10-30 minutes.

## Developer Quickstart
```bash
pip install spacepilot
sky launch spacepilot.yaml
```

## FastMCP Tool Signature
```json
{
  "name": "spacepilot_direct_scene",
  "description": "Direct a generative cinema scene with 3D camera trajectory, seed stepping, and Kokoro voice mastering.",
  "parameters": {
    "prompt": "string",
    "camera_pan": "number (deg -45..+45)",
    "camera_zoom": "number (ratio 1.0..2.5)",
    "voice_preset": "string (af_bella, af_sarah, am_adam, bf_emma)",
    "music_lufs": "number (-16.0)",
    "num_takes": "integer (1..4)"
  }
}
```

## API Endpoint Reference
- POST `/api/generate` — Dispatch video generation job
- POST `/api/generate/voice` — In-process Kokoro TTS generation
- POST `/api/generate/music` — Background soundtrack synthesis & ducking
- GET `/api/gpu/status` — Real-time telemetry, VRAM usage & dead man timer
- POST `/api/gpu/launch` — Provision AWS Spot / Shadeform instance
- POST `/api/gpu/terminate` — Immediately release GPU node
